name: triangle pose trikonasana
description: From a wide stance, reach sideways over the front leg with arms in a line. It stretches the hamstrings, hips and sides.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
